name: Marcus Vance
goals: Buy durable, repairable hardware or clean developer tools
price_sensitivity: low for utility, high for fluff
quit_triggers: Buzzword-heavy copy with no technical specs
Email wall or account creation before pricing
Claims that break physics or battery/compute limits

name: Priya Nair
goals: Save money while upgrading a small apartment
Avoid impulse purchases she will regret
quit_triggers: Price over $35 without clear value or a discount
Tiny buttons or horizontal scroll on mobile
A near-identical item elsewhere for half the price

name: Elena Rostova
goals: Reclaim 30 minutes a day on household logistics
Safe, reliable products that work out of the box
quit_triggers: Unclear shipping timeline or refund terms
Multi-step onboarding or a required companion app
Comments questioning safety or build quality

name: Devon Brooks
goals: Find camera-ready products before they go mainstream
quit_triggers: Product looks like generic dropshipped plastic

name: Arthur Pendelton
role: Small business owner and pragmatic skeptic
goals: Only spend on proven tools with measurable ROI
quit_triggers: Hidden subscription after an upfront purchase
No founder identity, address or support contact
Overpromised 'AI-powered' magic for a simple task

name: Chloe Kim
goals: Support honest materials and low-waste packaging
Spot greenwashing and lazy AI mockups
quit_triggers: Obvious AI artifacts in product shots
Vague eco claims with no material breakdown
